title: Passing Yards Speed Step 7 Same-Session Full Analysis Transition
objective: Measure and remove the remaining user-visible delay caused by the lazy-shell Load Full Analysis transition, without changing any frozen football/model/data/projection/context/probability/market/sportsbook behavior.
current_first_broken_arrow: Lazy shell -> Load Full Analysis -> selected-QB full detail ready
diagnostic_action: One branch browser profile proving whether the current V79 Load Full Analysis anchor causes a full document navigation and measuring click-to-ready versus frozen V77 server-render telemetry.

current_failure_epoch.root_cause: The first transition profiler waited only for final V59 readiness and did not record the post-click page/tab/URL state, so the failing transition owner could not be proven.
current_failure_epoch.patch: Instrument href target, context page count, active URL and post-click page selection only. No product/runtime/model/data/math changes.

root_cause.conclusion: Legacy V79 Load Full Analysis anchor is sanitized/rendered with target=_blank. The current Streamlit document remains on the lazy URL, so ks_py_full=1 never activates in the existing session.

product_patch.description: Remove the active legacy V79 load anchor from the lazy shell and replace activation with a native Streamlit button that sets ks_py_full=1 and reruns the same session. Delegate full analysis unchanged to frozen V82.

navigation_change_scope: Activation transport only: ks_py_full=1 in current session; existing date/matchup/QB/hints preserved.
acceptance_gates: 1 root cause locked from live transition evidence
9 public same-session transition faster than Step6 4.320s baseline
10 successful public job emits PASSING_YARDS_SPEED_STEP7_GREEN + PASSING_YARDS_SPEED_STEP7_FROZEN
next_required_state: Current-head Step7 static + branch live proof GREEN and DevSystem GREEN
